messages.author: b19f231547b6c85d
messages.subject: facet_grid with 3 factors
parts:
When I try the following facet_grid example with 3 factors, is it me
or are the top labels get all mixed up?

fac1 <- gl(2, 4, labels = c("fac1A", "fac1B") )
fac2 <- factor(rep(rep(1:2, c(2, 2) ), 2), labels = c("fac2C",
"fac2D") )
fac3 <- factor(rep(1:2, 4), labels = c("fac3E", "fac3F") )
dummy <- data.frame(x = rnorm(4), y = rnorm(4), fac1, fac2, fac3)
qplot(x, y, data = dummy, facets = fac1 ~ fac2 + fac3)

Thanks

messages.author: d588a03e58ea7e7f
messages.subject: Re: facet_grid with 3 factors
parts:
On Mar 17, 1:50 am, elaliberte <etiennelalibe...@gmail.com> wrote:
> When I try the following facet_grid example with 3 factors, is it me
> or are the top labels get all mixed up?
>
> fac1 <- gl(2, 4, labels = c("fac1A", "fac1B") )
> fac2 <- factor(rep(rep(1:2, c(2, 2) ), 2), labels = c("fac2C",
> "fac2D") )
> fac3 <- factor(rep(1:2, 4), labels = c("fac3E", "fac3F") )
> dummy <- data.frame(x = rnorm(4), y = rnorm(4), fac1, fac2, fac3)
> qplot(x, y, data = dummy, facets = fac1 ~ fac2 + fac3)
>
> Thanks

It's not just you. I saw the same thing. The labels across the top
are:

fac2D fac3E fac2D fac3F
fac2C fac3E fac2C fac3F

when they should be (and the data corresponds to)

fac2C fac2C fac2D fac2D
fac3E fac3E fac3E fac3E

I _think_ the following patch to facet-grid-.r would fix it, but I'm
not able to test it. Even if not, I think the problem is in the call
to grobGrid that creates striphGrid in facet-grid-.r line 116.

--Brian Diggs


R/facet-grid-.r | 2 +-
1 files changed, 1 insertions(+), 1 deletions(-)

diff --git a/R/facet-grid-.r b/R/facet-grid-.r
index 615e04d..89bf169 100644
--- a/R/facet-grid-.r
+++ b/R/facet-grid-.r
@@ -115,7 +115,7 @@ FacetGrid <- proto(Facet, {
function(i) do.call("max2", strip_heights[i, ])))
striphGrid <- grobGrid(
"strip_h", labels$h, nrow = nrow(labels$h), ncol = ncol(labels
$h),
- heights = strip_heights
+ heights = strip_heights, as.table = .$as.table
)

# Add background and foreground to panels

messages.author: affa918ed63b6275
messages.subject: Re: facet_grid with 3 factors
parts:
In FacetGrid$add_guides: (in facet-grid-.r)

# Strips
labels <- .$labels_default(.$shape, theme)

# add these two lines:
labels$v<-matrix(c(t(labels$v)),nrow=nrow(labels$v), ncol=ncol(labels$v))
labels$h<-matrix(c(t(labels$h)),nrow=nrow(labels$h), ncol=ncol(labels$h))

I think this will work but is ad-hoc solution.
Maybe grobGrid() is designed for operating the grid of panel, so it
changes the 2-d order of matrix.
